F-15.summary: backend/alembic/versions/002_seed_items.py:55-58 calls op.execute(sa.text(...), item) with a 2nd positional arg; alembic 1.13.1 Operations.execute signature is (self, sqltext, *, execution_options=None) -> raises TypeError: execute() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 were given. So 001->002 chain cannot reach head; item_bank seed (19 rows) is never applied via migration. Root cause was latent because there is NO repo-wide alembic execution path (zero hits in CI/compose/deploy/scripts/runbook/Dockerfile); real table creation uses Base.metadata.create_all (app/core/database.py:42, app/db/init_db.py:15, tests/conftest.py:68). F-15.disposition: Recorded by M0-004 read-only audit; NOT fixed in M0-004 (002_seed_items.py is out of the audit's forbidden-to-change scope). Requires separate FIX-M0-004-001 before M2 Knowledge Core migrations rely on the alembic chain. Candidate fix: op.get_bind().execute(sa.text(...), item) or sa.text(...).bindparams(**item); also review 002 seed idempotency + wide DELETE downgrade per 50-database rules.
